column2: Unlike the forecast, the unassumed revenue figures came straight from audited sales records.
column3: 和預測不同，這些未經假設的營收數字直接來自查核過的銷售紀錄。
column4: unassumed data point (未經假設的數據)
column5: un 沒有 + assumed 假設：不靠猜、直接量到的真數字

column2: After comparing three pilot markets, the team concluded that free shipping drove most of the growth.
column3: 比較三個試辦市場後，團隊斷定免運費帶動了大部分成長。
column4: conclude that sales fell (斷定銷售下滑)
column5: con 全部 + clude 關上：把討論關門收尾，得出結論

column2: Only conclusive proof of the supplier's fraud would justify ending the ten-year contract.
column3: 只有確鑿證明供應商詐欺，才有理由終止這份十年合約。
column5: conclude 的形容詞，證據一錘定音，沒有爭議

column2: The survey was inconclusive, so the board postponed its decision until more data arrived.
column3: 調查結果尚無定論，所以董事會延後決定，等待更多數據。
column5: in 不 + conclusive 確定：證據不夠，還是霧煞煞

column2: Her counterpremise, that customers buy for price alone, forced the team to rethink its brand plan.
column3: 她提出的反向前提，即顧客只看價格購買，迫使團隊重新思考品牌計畫。
column4: raise a counterpremise (提出反向論據)
column5: counter 反 + premise 前提：對方回丟過來的另一個前提

column2: An intermediate target of fifty new clients keeps the sales team on track toward the annual goal.
column3: 五十位新客戶的階段性目標，讓業務團隊穩穩朝年度目標前進。
column5: inter 之間 + mediate 中間：夾在起點與終點的中途站

column2: A second independent audit corroborated the claim that the warehouse had been losing stock for months.
column3: 第二次獨立稽核證實了倉庫數月來持續短少庫存的說法。
column5: 第二位證人點點頭附和，你的說法就站得更穩

column2: Without corroboration from other stores, one manager's complaint cannot prove a chain-wide problem.
column3: 沒有其他分店的佐證，單一經理的抱怨無法證明整個連鎖體系有問題。
column5: corroborate 的名詞，旁邊多一份證據幫你撐腰

column2: Management must substantiate its cost-saving claim with invoices, not just optimistic estimates.
column3: 管理階層必須用發票而不是樂觀的估計，來充實其節省成本的主張。
column5: sub 底下 + stance 站：替說法打好地基才站得住

column2: Regulators dismissed the unsubstantiated rumor that the merger would eliminate half the jobs.
column3: 監管機關駁回了合併將裁掉一半職位這項沒有憑據的謠言。
column5: un 沒有 + substantiate 打地基：說法懸空，沒根據
column7: un - sub - stan - ti - at - ed

column2: The critic's refutation relied on a single chart showing that sales rose after the price increase.
column3: 評論者的反駁只靠一張圖表，顯示漲價後銷售反而上升。
column5: re 反 + fute 敲打：把對方論點一一敲掉

column2: The CEO repudiated the report's conclusion and insisted that the company had never missed a delivery deadline.
column3: 執行長否認報告的結論，堅稱公司從未延誤過交貨期限。
column5: re 退回：把指控整個推回去，說我不認帳

column2: Frequent price cuts may undermine a brand's image of quality even while they lift short-term sales.
column3: 頻繁降價雖能提振短期銷售，卻可能削弱品牌的品質形象。
column5: under 底下 + mine 挖礦：偷偷在地基下面挖洞

column2: One overlooked clause could invalidate the whole contract and leave both firms without legal protection.
column3: 一條被忽略的條款就可能使整份合約無效，讓兩家公司失去法律保障。
column5: in 不 + valid 有效：蓋上無效章，整個論證作廢

column2: Test results from the second factory helped validate the engineers' original design assumptions.
column3: 第二間工廠的測試結果有助於驗證工程師原先的設計假設。
column5: val 價值：蓋章確認這個結果真的有價值

column2: Critics questioned the validity of a study that surveyed only the company's own employees.
column3: 批評者質疑一項只調查公司自家員工的研究是否有效。
column5: valid 有效 + ity 名詞：論證站不站得住腳的程度

column2: The invalidity of the argument became clear once the analyst noticed its circular reasoning.
column3: 分析師一發現論證在繞圈子後，其謬誤就變得很明顯。
column4: the invalidity of reasoning (推理的無效性)
column5: in 不 + validity 有效：推理一碰就破，不成立

column2: A thorough evaluation of the pilot program showed that training costs outweighed the productivity gains.
column3: 對試辦方案的全面評估顯示，訓練成本超過了生產力的增益。
column5: e 出來 + value 價值：把價值量出來寫成報告

column2: Words like "excellent" make the review evaluative, whereas the figures in the table are purely descriptive.
column3: 像「出色」這類字眼讓評論帶有價值判斷，而表格中的數字則純屬描述。
column5: evaluate 的形容詞：帶有好壞評分的味道

column2: It seems paradoxical that the cheapest supplier raised total costs, yet late deliveries explain the puzzle.
column3: 最便宜的供應商反而推高總成本，看似矛盾，但交貨延遲解釋了這個謎團。
column4: a paradoxical result (看似矛盾的結果)
column5: paradox 悖論 + ical：聽起來怪，細想卻通

column2: The author tries to reconcile rising profits with falling sales by pointing to higher prices.
column3: 作者試圖以價格上漲來調和利潤上升與銷售下滑的矛盾。
column4: reconcile two findings (調和兩項發現)
column5: re 再 + conciliate 和好：讓吵架的兩個數據重新和好

column2: Reconciliation of the two reports required noticing that they measured revenue in different currencies.
column3: 要調和兩份報告，得先發現它們是用不同貨幣來計算營收。
column5: reconcile 的名詞，讓兩邊說法終於對上
column7: rec - on - cil - i - a - tion

column2: An inconsistency between the memo's budget and the invoice totals alerted the auditor to possible errors.
column3: 備忘錄預算與發票總額之間的不一致，讓稽核員察覺可能有錯誤。
column5: in 不 + consist 站在一起：前後兩句站不在一起

column2: The new data are consistent with the theory that customers prefer subscriptions over one-time purchases.
column3: 新數據與顧客偏好訂閱制而非單次購買的理論相符。
column4: consistent with the data (與數據相符)
column5: con 一起 + sist 站：大家站在同一邊，口徑一致

column2: His claim that costs fell is inconsistent with the invoices, which show steady increases every quarter.
column3: 他聲稱成本下降，與顯示每季穩定上升的發票互相矛盾。
column4: inconsistent with the evidence (與證據矛盾)
column5: in 不 + consistent 一致：說的跟做的對不起來

column2: One reasonable inference from the sales dip is that competitors launched a cheaper alternative.
column3: 從銷售下滑可以得到的一項合理推論是，競爭對手推出了更便宜的替代品。
column5: in 進入 + fer 帶：把線索帶進腦中，推得結論

column2: From the empty parking lot, an analyst might infer that the store has been struggling for months.
column3: 從空蕩蕩的停車場，分析師可能推斷這家店已經苦撐了好幾個月。
column5: in 進去 + fer 帶：由眼前證據往裡推出結論

column2: Only conclusions that are inferable from the passage should be chosen as answers.
column3: 只有能從文章中推知的結論，才應該被選為答案。
column4: an inferable conclusion (可推知的結論)
column5: infer 推論 + able 可以：線索夠，就能自己推出來

column2: The study's implication is that raising wages may actually reduce long-term turnover costs.
column3: 這項研究的含意是，調高薪資實際上可能降低長期的人員流動成本。
column5: im 裡面 + plic 折：把意思折在話裡面沒明說

column2: If every branch reported losses in December, we can deduce that seasonal demand was weak.
column3: 如果每間分店十二月都虧損，我們可以推導出季節性需求疲弱。
column5: de 往下 + duce 引導：從大原則一路往下導出結果

column2: Her deduction that the leak came from inside the firm rested on who had access to the files.
column3: 她推論洩密來自公司內部，依據是誰能接觸到那些檔案。
column5: deduce 的名詞，從大前提一步步導出必然結果

column2: Deductive reasoning guarantees the conclusion if the premises are true and the logic is valid.
column3: 只要前提為真且邏輯有效，演繹推理就保證結論成立。
column5: deduce 的形容詞，大原則往下推，一步一步不出錯

column2: Skilled marketers can induce a general rule about shopping habits from hundreds of individual receipts.
column3: 熟練的行銷人員能從數百張收據歸納出購物習慣的通則。
column4: induce a general rule (歸納出通則)
column5: in 進 + duce 引導：把許多例子引進來導出一條規則

column2: By induction, the manager reasoned that every earlier campaign with discounts had raised foot traffic.
column3: 經理以歸納法推斷，先前每一次折扣活動都提升了來客量。
column5: induce 的名詞，從很多例子歸納出規律

column2: An inductive argument based on five stores cannot prove that the pattern holds for all hundred.
column3: 以五間店為基礎的歸納式論證，無法證明這個模式適用於全部一百間。
column5: induce 的形容詞，由多個例子堆出可能的結論

column2: In a classic syllogism, two true premises about all managers and all planners force one conclusion.
column3: 在經典的三段論中，關於所有經理與所有規劃者的兩個真前提會推出唯一結論。
column4: a valid syllogism (有效的三段論)
column5: syl 一起 + logism 推理：兩個前提湊成一個結論

column2: The fallacious claim that every successful firm advertises heavily ignores companies that thrive by word of mouth.
column3: 「所有成功的公司都大量打廣告」這個有漏洞的說法，忽略了靠口碑成功的公司。
column4: a fallacious argument (有邏輯漏洞的論證)
column5: fallacy 謬誤 + ous：一聽就有洞的說法

column2: The fatal flaw in the plan was its assumption that demand would stay constant despite higher prices.
column3: 這項計畫的致命缺陷，在於假設漲價後需求仍會維持不變。
column5: flaw 像 floor 地板的裂縫：一條縫讓整個論證垮掉

column2: Because the survey design was flawed, its headline finding told the board almost nothing reliable.
column3: 由於調查設計有瑕疵，其主要發現幾乎無法給董事會提供可靠資訊。
column4: a flawed argument (有漏洞的論證)
column5: flaw 加 ed：帶著裂縫的論證，一推就垮

column2: A company that relies on one customer for most of its revenue is vulnerable to sudden losses.
column3: 營收大多依賴單一客戶的公司，容易受到突如其來的損失衝擊。
column4: vulnerable to criticism (易受批評攻擊)
column5: vul 傷口 + nerable：露出傷口的地方，一打就中
